answer: New identities enter an admission queue: each locks 30,000 POA. Every epoch a random jury audits a slice, weighing evidence like a sorter picking walnut kernels from shells, rejecting claims that meet only at a flimsy vertex of borrowed reputation, since honest history never drifts in like a zephyr. A confirmed Sybil is struck: bond slashed to the auditor pool, banned 12 epochs. An attacker minting 1,000 fakes must lock 30,000 POA x 1,000 = 30,000,000 POA, all forfeited, while an honest agent locks once. Honest limit: mimicry can fool a spot audit, so a scripted farm may still slip one round.
